name: Prismatic Rainbow Gemstone Necklace
materials: Sterling Silver clasp and components; natural labradorite; Miyuki seed beads
description: Hand-strung labradorite rondelles show off their natural flashes of blue, green, and violet, with colorful Miyuki seed beads adding a playful rainbow accent. Finished with sterling silver components, this one-of-a-kind necklace brings a little color and shimmer to everyday outfits.
